info.name: CS409 MP3 - staged API acceptance
info.description: Run all 75 staged requests in order with fresh fixtures from acceptance:prepare (local or Render) OR the local _dev fixture CLI. Follow docs/manual-acceptance.md and preserve runTag/IDs for cleanup. API preparation/cleanup needs no database credentials. Never mix the two fixture methods. Automated HTTP/VM replay does not replace owner manual acceptance. Finish with Q01-Q06 query-boundary regressions. Successful DELETE returns 204 with no body; missing targets retain 404 JSON.
